props.game: New York Rangers @ Detroit Red Wings
props.reason: Fox is the Rangers' top power-play quarterback and consistently racks up primary assists on the man advantage. Even-money on a 0.5 assist line for an elite playmaking defenseman is strong value.
Ovechkin remains a focal point of Washington's top power-play unit and gets heavy offensive zone starts. Plus-money for a point or more from an all-time elite scorer is excellent value.

Ovechkin's career built on elite shot volume and one-timer accuracy from the left circle gives him anytime-goal equity every night. The Hurricanes' defense can be tested by his shot-first approach on the power play.
Pastrnak is Boston's primary shooter and power-play trigger man, routinely piling up shot attempts. Plus-money on a 3.5 shots line for a high-volume shooter is a solid price.
Robertson is a top-line Dallas forward who produces multi-point games at a high rate, especially at home. The plus-money price on a multi-point over offers good value given his skill level.

props.game: New York Rangers @ Detroit Red Wings
props.reason: DeBrincat is a skilled playmaker who should see significant power-play time for Detroit. Plus-money for just one assist is attractive value given his passing ability.
Perfetti has emerged as a consistent shot generator in Winnipeg's top-six, often exceeding two shots per game. The short price reflects reliable volume for this line.

Gauthier has developed into a high-volume shooter for Anaheim's top line, often testing goaltenders at a high rate. The plus-money price offers good value for a player trending toward increased shot attempts.
